text: before you fix it, can produce a test that fails, we need to improve the test approach for this exact type of mismatch behavior because all green is effectively useless when it isnt true end to end
resolution: Built the EDITOR↔COMPILED render parity harness the all-green gap demanded: compile/worldParity.test.ts classifies a 0.1m probe grid as opaque/open against BOTH the editor's pieceVisualShapes and the baked instance rows and requires agreement at every probe, plus the player's invariant (a body-passable point must never be opaquely rendered — walk-through implies see-through, the exact req_0654 hidden-wall repro). To let a headless suite import the editor's look, the pure shape math moved out of pieceMeshes.tsx into React-free editors/build/pieceShapes.ts (BUILD_UI included; old surfaces re-export, no import site changed, adjacent suites stay green). Committed RED by design at 4feaa90bb: 3/15 pass — all 7 wall edits + open door fail parity, the arch is opaquely rendered at walk-through probes, the window ships no pane, and the harness even caught an unknown 26-probe elevator-header divergence. The fix (req_0654) turns it green next; the suite then stands guard against this whole mismatch class.
